calibration.source: TFC_WALTER_FINAL_imprimir.pdf, UFPB 2016, pp. 42-47 and Table 4.1 p.52
calibration.scope: first reactor only; downstream columns and second reactor are not dynamic models here
calibration.kinetic_unit_status: confirmed kmol/(s m3) in supplied Luyben 2011 p.656; printed TCC min label corrected
calibration.gas_constant: 1.987 cal/mol/K; printed kcal is inconsistent with activation energies in cal/mol
calibration.heat_capacity_status: printed constant energy-balance coefficients retained; effective Q inferred, not identified plant duty
calibration.temperature_limit_status: new imposed research limit; no hard limit stated in TCC
calibration.added_actuator: heat-removal duty supported by ASPEN/aspeneb.dynf R1_TC.OP -> R1.QR; ideal input and 0.6-1.4 bounds are new study assumptions
calibration.aspen_duty_warning: effective 25.24 MW of printed-ODE reconstruction differs from paper 10.3 MW and archive snapshots; not an Aspen thermodynamic reproduction
calibration.density_warning: printed constant reactor molar density and sum of computed concentrations differ; inherited reduced-model approximation retained
calibration.valve_flow_bounds: 0.04-2.0 fE0, equal-percentage rangeability 50 and capacity factor 2 from TCC
calibration.original_Q_sample_period_Qcov_Rcov_PI_ga: not specified sufficiently to recover exactly

new_cases.servo_up: +10% xEB at 3 h, nominal at 7 h
new_cases.servo_down: -10% xEB at 3 h, nominal at 7 h
new_cases.thermal_loss: 20% unobserved heat-removal efficiency loss at 5 h
new_cases.kinetics_noise: k1 +25%, k2 -10%, k3 +10%, input noise 3x at 5 h; T sensor missing 5.5-6 h

initial_condition: nominal steady state, common biased estimate; no unrecoverable historical startup included in control score

noise.pairing: same independent innovations by case/seed/time across every configuration

information: commanded inputs only; future disturbances not previewed; true concentrations are scoring labels only

state_prediction.physical: printed balances with documented unit correction/effective Q

estimators.lstm_ukf: physical prediction, genuine LSTM predicts positive Q factors from past
estimators.nake: learned dynamics, UKF/Joseph correction, previous NIS EWMA scales positive Q
estimators.lstm_nake: learned dynamics, UKF/Joseph correction, separately trained genuine LSTM adapts Q

nake_status: research working name; no KalmanNet reproduction or neural Kalman-gain training

controllers.siso: xEB tracking via ethylene flow; Q command fixed
controllers.mimo: xEB and T tracking via ethylene flow and Q

comparison: MIMO adds a thermal objective and actuator; direct xEB ranking is accompanied by temperature/effort metrics

constraints.note: prediction feasibility does not guarantee actual noisy plant temperature

solver.name: SciPy SLSQP; physical CasADi C derivatives, neural exact C chain rule checked against CasADi

fallback: constrained infeasible: fE minimum and Q maximum in MIMO; may override normal move-rate bound; unconstrained: previous command
stopped_runs: guard at T>220 C, T<0 C, negative concentration or numerical failure; flagged and excluded from full-duration matched rankings
scope: first reactor; not a full Aspen plantwide study; no experimental plant data
